description.zh: 流程ID，即为在创建WhatsApp Flow时通过[CreateFlow](~~2638742~~)接口返回的FlowId。
description.en: The flow ID. This is the FlowId returned by the [CreateFlow](~~2638742~~) operation when you create a WhatsApp flow.

descriptions.zh:
- 您在创建WhatsApp Flow后，可通过此接口获取流程预览URL，以预览您的流程。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有成功创建的WhatsApp Flow。

- 若您没有已成功创建的WhatsApp Flow，可调用[CreateFlow](~~2638742~~)接口创建WhatsApp Flow。


#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- After you create a WhatsApp flow, call this operation to generate a temporary preview URL for the flow.

- Before you call this operation, make sure that you have created a WhatsApp flow.

- If you do not have a WhatsApp flow, you can call the [CreateFlow](~~2638742~~) API to create one.

#### QPS limit

This operation allows a maximum of 5 requests per second per account. Excess requests are throttled and may result in service interruptions.
